Doctrine pack for organizing a TypeScript app around the ECS ≡ Effect ≡ Hexagonal Architecture isomorphism. Cycle 1 names the four-folder pattern (domain · ports · live · mock), the suffix-as-type discipline that makes behavior surfaces grep-enumerable, and the delete-heavy refactor recipe with FAGAN gates. Cycle 2 adds the adopt-don't-invent positional doctrine: hand-port-with-drift for upstream type adoption, doc-only-then-runtime for unblocked adoption, lift-pattern-template for mechanical Service addition, state-ownership-matrix for multi-Service composition.
